headline: Totals are rounded to cents and the legacy tax helper is removed.
summary: total() now rounds its result. legacy_tax() was deleted although checkout() still calls it.

safety.text: A removed helper is still referenced by checkout().

behavior_changes.summary: Totals are rounded; the tax helper is gone.
behavior_changes.before_pseudocode:
total: return the sum of items
legacy_tax: return amount times 0.2
behavior_changes.after_pseudocode:
total: return the sum of items rounded to 2 digits
rounding: return value rounded to 2 digits
uncertainties: Callers of the removed helper were not analysed.
